# tcpshield Provider

Manage [TCPShield](https://tcpshield.com) networks, domains, backend sets, firewalls, Bedrock tunnels and Sentry tunnels as code.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    tcpshield = {
      source = "kirchdev/tcpshield"
    }
  }
}

# The API key may also come from TCPSHIELD_API_KEY.
provider "tcpshield" {
  api_key = var.tcpshield_api_key
}

variable "tcpshield_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) TCPShield API key (panel → Account → API). May also be set via the `TCPSHIELD_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the TCPShield API. Defaults to `https://api.tcpshield.com`. May also be set via `TCPSHIELD_ENDPOINT`.
